occurrences.text: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
